jobs.title: Houston Unarmed Level II Security Officer — Protect & Serve
jobs.description:
TriCorps is seeking a dedicated Unarmed Level II Security Officer for our Houston operations. The role requires a valid Texas PSB Level II License, reliability, and strong communication. Both full-time and part-time positions are available to support client sites with professional security presence.

Location: Houston, TX. Pay: $18.75 per hour. Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance, paid vacation and paid sick days. Join a team committed to integrity and client service.
